executiveSummary.purpose: Define the final product-facing UI architecture and role-based operational experience before implementing new field and management interfaces in subsequent blocks.
coreMandates: Architecture and UX definition only; no redesigned interfaces implemented in BLOCK 76
I18N remains strictly FROZEN with exactly 1,128 keys per locale and zero drift
Strict preservation of business logic, pricing logic, trip state machine, security rules, schemas, and fixtures
Four major interface areas cleanly isolated: Field Operations, Projects, Field Reports, and Central Dashboard
Zero invented roles; 100% adherence to existing RBAC (SUPER_ADMIN, PROJECT_ADMIN, SUPERVISOR, SITE_SUPERVISOR, DISPATCHER, SCALE_OPERATOR, FINANCE_AUDITOR, DRIVER, VIEWER)

area1_fieldOperations.description: High-velocity, touch-optimized field interfaces for scale operators, field receivers, supervisors, and drivers operating at desert, highway, and project site weighbridges.

subInterfaces.purpose: Rapid outbound vehicle identification, tare/gross weight recording, validation checks, electronic weigh ticket generation, and trip dispatch.
emptyStates: No pending trucks in scale queue; prompt operator to enter license plate or scan barcode.
successStates: Trip dispatched successfully with unique Ticket ID, synchronized to cloud or buffered in Mutation Queue.
subInterfaces.offlineBehavior: 100% functional offline using IndexedDB activeTrips and mutationQueue with local ticket sequence generation.

responsiveBehavior.mobile: Single-step wizard with 44px+ touch presets, large numeric keypad for weights, camera barcode scanner.
responsiveBehavior.tablet: Split view: vehicle & material picker on left, live weight scale & ticket preview on right.
responsiveBehavior.desktop: Comprehensive high-density weighbridge console with live scale COM-port feed and recent dispatch log.

shortestSafeWorkflow: 1. Identify Truck by Plate Number (or barcode scan) -> Auto-fill default Tare & Carrier
3. Select Carrier & Assign Driver (with license validity verification)
4. Select Material Type & Applicable Pricing Rule Snapshot
5. Record Tare Weight (from weighbridge scale or verified preset)
7. System calculates Net Weight = Gross - Tare & performs axle limit validation
8. Verify Ticket Preview and click 'Issue Ticket & Dispatch' (Creates Trip in LOADED status)

subInterfaces.purpose: Inbound truck reception, destination weighbridge recording, origin vs destination weight variance verification, automated exception flagging, and receipt sign-off.
primaryActions: Record Destination Gross & Tare (or Direct Net)
blockingStates: Trip Not Found or Not in IN_TRANSIT/ARRIVED status
Severe Weight Deficit > 5% without supervisor reason
warningStates: Variance exceeds tolerance (e.g. > 1.5% or > 500kg) requiring mandatory discrepancy note
emptyStates: No inbound trip selected. Search by Waybill #, Ticket ID, or Truck Plate.
successStates: Trip marked COMPLETED, variance snapshot stored, settlement base locked.
subInterfaces.offlineBehavior: Search cached active trips in IndexedDB; buffer destination weigh receipt in mutationQueue with cryptographic hash.

responsiveBehavior.mobile: Single-hand mobile reception flow: big camera scan button, instant match summary, 2 large weight inputs, 1 green 'Accept' button.
responsiveBehavior.tablet: Trip manifest on top half, dual-scale weight calculator and variance gauge on bottom half.
responsiveBehavior.desktop: Dense multi-lane inbound terminal dashboard with automatic weighbridge indicator.

shortestSafeWorkflow: 1. Enter Waybill/Ticket ID or search Truck Plate Number
2. System matches active Trip in IN_TRANSIT or ARRIVED status
3. Record Destination Arrival Timestamp and Unloader ID
4. Record Destination Gross & Tare Weights (or Direct Net Weight)
5. System evaluates Variance: Dest Net vs Origin Net against Project Tolerance Rules
6. If Variance > Tolerance: Trigger automated EXCEPTION flag and require supervisor justification note
7. Confirm Unloading -> Transition Trip to COMPLETED status

subInterfaces.purpose: Holistic on-site supervision: monitoring active trips in real time, resolving operational exceptions, importing daily weighbridge batch files, mapping unresolved entities, and intervening in stalled dispatches.
blockingStates: Unresolved High-Risk Exceptions blocking project invoicing
Pending human review on import batch containing ambiguous records
warningStates: Pending settlement buffer nearing daily cap
emptyStates: All clear: zero pending exceptions and no uncommitted import batches.
successStates: Exception approved with immutable audit log; batch successfully committed into trip repository.
subInterfaces.offlineBehavior: Read-only access to cached trips; supervisor decisions queued in local outbox until connectivity restored.

responsiveBehavior.mobile: Tabbed cards view: 'Alerts', 'Trips', 'Imports' with swipe actions for quick approval/rejection.
responsiveBehavior.tablet: Master-detail layout: exception/batch list on left, decision payload and audit history on right.
responsiveBehavior.desktop: Full command center: live KPI metrics, active map/grid, exception triage table, and batch upload drop-zone.

supervisionCapabilities: Active Trips Monitoring: Real-time tracking of trips across LOADED, IN_TRANSIT, ARRIVED, UNLOADING states
Pending Decisions: Direct resolution of WEIGHT_DISCREPANCY, UNAPPROVED_ROUTE, DRIVER_CARRIER_CONFLICT
Weighbridge Imports: 12-stage validation pipeline for Excel/CSV files directly from site bridge scales
Entity Resolution: Interactive fuzzy matching for raw bridge strings to master carrier/truck/driver IDs
Daily Performance Review: Shift-level tonnage, total trips, variance percentages, and carrier adherence

subInterfaces.purpose: Simple, focused driver interface to view currently assigned active trips, verify cargo details, mark site arrival (ARRIVED), and present digital electronic ticket QR/barcode.
primaryActions: Present Digital Ticket to Weighbridge Operator
blockingStates: No active trip assigned to driver's Iqama/ID
warningStates: Poor network connectivity (arrival timestamp buffered locally)
emptyStates: لا توجد رحلات مسندة حالياً (No active trips currently assigned. Contact Dispatcher.)
successStates: Arrival timestamp registered; trip transitioned to ARRIVED; ready for weighbridge entry.
subInterfaces.offlineBehavior: Full offline viewing of active trip details; 'Arrive' button stores action in local Mutation Queue.

responsiveBehavior.mobile: Single column card-first design: large text, high contrast for outdoor sunlight, 56px large touch action button.
responsiveBehavior.tablet: Centered card with large digital barcode.

strictlySupportedCapabilities: View assigned active trip(s) matching Driver ID
Trigger ARRIVED state transition via State Machine
Display electronic ticket number and QR code for destination scan
View route origin and destination site information
NO unauthorized capabilities: Driver CANNOT create trips, edit weights, or approve exceptions

area2_projectsInterface.description: Comprehensive project lifecycle management, configuration of operational parameters, master data governance, and role-based project user assignments.

subInterfaces.purpose: Display all projects accessible by the authenticated user with status, active fleet count, daily tonnage, and configuration health.
subInterfaces.accessControl: Filtered strictly by authContext.assignedProjectIds (or all for SUPER_ADMIN)

subInterfaces.purpose: Step-by-step creation of new project entities: metadata, site geofences, weight tolerances, carrier associations, initial pricing rules, and user role assignments.
Manage project operational rules: default weight tolerance thresholds (percentage and kg), shift schedules, operating zones, and settlement terms.
subInterfaces.accessControl: PROJECT_ADMIN of specific project, or SUPER_ADMIN

subInterfaces.purpose: Manage master entities associated with the project: Authorized Carriers, Registered Trucks (with tare calibration), Drivers (with license check), and Materials (with pricing mapping).
subInterfaces.accessControl: PROJECT_ADMIN of specific project, or SUPER_ADMIN

subInterfaces.purpose: Assign users to project, designate roles (DISPATCHER, SCALE_OPERATOR, SUPERVISOR, FINANCE_AUDITOR), and enforce least-privilege principles.
subInterfaces.accessControl: PROJECT_ADMIN of specific project, or SUPER_ADMIN

managementDistinction.projectManagement: Scoped strictly to specific project: configuration, master data, local users, and pricing rules within assignedProjectIds.
managementDistinction.fieldOperation: Execution-only: creating and receiving trips without ability to modify project parameters, master contracts, or pricing.
managementDistinction.centralAdministration: System-wide: global user directory, cross-project tenant provisioning, system audits, and global security policies.

area3_fieldReportsInterface.description: Enterprise-grade operational and financial reporting engine providing analytics, multi-criteria filtering, and compliant exports.

subReports: Origin vs Destination Weight Variance Analysis
Priced vs Pending Settlement Audit Log
Unresolved Entity Resolution Rate & Manual Overrides
Operational Exceptions Severity & SLA Resolution Report

preservedBusinessRules: Operation Source Type isolation: clearly distinguish MANUAL, WEIGHBRIDGE, EXCEL, CSV, GOOGLE_SHEETS, API imports
Pending Settlement separation: trips with incomplete weights or missing pricing rules quarantined as 'pending settlement' without blocking operational metrics
Pricing Snapshot preservation: billing strictly calculated using frozen pricingRuleSnapshot captured at dispatch time
Finalized Settlement calculations: strictly server-side evaluated using locked formulas (rate * base + VAT)
Weight Variance governance: variance strictly evaluated as (destNetWeight - originNetWeight) / originNetWeight * 100
Export governance: multi-format export (PDF, XLSX, CSV) respects project scoping and sensitive data masking

area4_centralDashboard.description: Executive and management overview providing real-time strategic intelligence, cross-project KPIs, settlement health, and exception alerts.

informationHierarchy.title: Active & Pending Trips Overview
components: Trip Status Funnel (DRAFT -> LOADED -> IN_TRANSIT -> ARRIVED -> UNLOADING -> COMPLETED)

area4_centralDashboard.managementDiscipline: The Central Dashboard is strictly designed for strategic executive visibility, trend analysis, and intervention dispatch. It must NEVER serve as an operational data entry console or replace field weighbridge stations.

existingRoles.description: Global enterprise administrator with unrestricted cross-project access.
Project-level manager responsible for project setup, master data, local users, and operational compliance.
Field supervisor overseeing weighbridge stations, exception decisions, and daily operational flow.
Origin weighbridge and logistics dispatcher managing outbound trips and vehicle assignments.
Weighbridge scale operator capturing tare and gross weights at loading or unloading scales.
Financial and settlement auditor verifying freight billing, VAT compliance, and pricing snapshots.
Truck driver executing physical transport with access restricted to assigned trip and arrival check-in.
Read-only stakeholder with observational access to reports and project statistics.

systemAndAdminDrawer.description: Preserves all existing 17 tabs, diagnostic engines, security audits, migration tools, and test suites under an organized secondary drawer to prevent functional loss.

fieldOperations.tablet: Two-column split view (Selector / Action), persistent status pill bar, floating primary action button.
fieldOperations.desktop: Comprehensive weighbridge console with auxiliary hardware status and queue monitor.

projects.phone: Card stack view with modal wizard steps, collapsible filters.
projects.tablet: Table with responsive column hiding, stepped wizard progress bar.
projects.desktop: Full multi-column data grid, master-detail side drawer for carrier/truck entity management.

fieldReports.phone: Summary metrics cards with expandable report sections, direct PDF/CSV export buttons.
fieldReports.tablet: Responsive analytics charts, compact data tables with horizontal scroll indicators.
fieldReports.desktop: Multi-filter sidebar, rich data visualization panels, dense financial data grid with sticky headers.

centralDashboard.phone: Vertical KPI metric cards stack, high-priority exception alerts carousel.
centralDashboard.tablet: 2x2 KPI grid, project comparison cards, interactive donut charts.
centralDashboard.desktop: Comprehensive executive bento-grid with real-time refresh, multi-project radar charts, and system status widgets.
